name: @bureaucromancer/lantern-app
description: The Magic Lantern web UI, built with Vite and served by the daemon.
dependencyNote: StoryEngine's client stack at StoryEngine's pins: React 19, TanStack Router (code-based routes, so no router plugin or generator) and TanStack Query. The daemon is reached only through lantern-client (rule 1). Testing Library is declared here rather than at the root, because a second copy of React fails as 'Invalid hook call'.
